details: The tension slider fires a full canvas redraw on every `input` event without RAF or debouncing, a mild update storm risk, though the canvas-based edge drawing is fast enough that jank is unlikely. All other criteria pass: pointer events unify mouse/touch, no D3 transitions are used in interactive handlers so there are no mid-flight race conditions, no scales are captured in stale closures, and the dispatch handlers never re-dispatch so no feedback loop can form despite the absence of a `source` guard.
